en-US.name: Contextify
en-US.subtitle: CLI AI Command Center
en-US.promotional_text: Search your entire Claude Code and Codex history instantly. Real-time tracking, AI summaries, all on your Mac.
en-US.description:
Stop losing track of AI coding conversations. Contextify monitors your Claude Code and Codex sessions, generates intelligent summaries and organizes every project automatically.

KEY FEATURES

• Full-Text Search – Find any conversation, code snippet, or topic across all your AI sessions instantly.
• Real-time Session Tracking – See every conversation update instantly, with directives from you mapped to completion responses from the AI.
• AI-Powered Summaries – Get intelligent recaps at a glance. Understand conversation flow without re-reading everything. All on your device.
• Project-Centric Organization – Switch between projects instantly. Contextify automatically organizes every session, no setup required.

GREAT FOR

• Software developers using AI coding assistants daily
• Developers who need to review and reference past AI interactions
• Anyone wanting organized Claude Code and Codex conversation history

HOW IT WORKS

Contextify runs as a lightweight native macOS HUD that monitors your ~/.claude/projects/ and ~/.codex/sessions/ directories. When you start a conversation with Claude Code or Codex, Contextify automatically detects it, tracks the conversation timeline in real-time, and generates intelligent summaries using advanced LLM processing.

All data is stored locally in a SQLite database with full support for custom locations (Dropbox, iCloud Drive). Your conversations remain private and under your control, nothing leaves your Mac.

PRIVACY & SECURITY

• All data stored locally on your Mac. It is never transmitted to external servers
• No cloud sync, no analytics, no tracking
• Security-scoped bookmark system for safe file access in sandboxed builds
• Full control over your conversation data with exportable Markdown artifacts

TECHNICAL DETAILS

• Built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI for native macOS performance
• Lightweight background monitoring with minimal CPU impact
• Real-time file system monitoring
• SQLite backend for fast queries and efficient storage
• Support for custom database locations (local, Dropbox, iCloud Drive)

review_information.notes:
SAMPLE DATA:
https://contextify.sh/review-4a125b1d/sample-data.zip

DEMO VIDEO:
https://contextify.sh/review-4a125b1d/demo-video.mp4

SETUP INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Download and extract sample-data.zip
2. Copy the claude/ folder contents to ~/.claude/projects/
3. Copy the codex/ folder contents to ~/.codex/sessions/
4. Launch Contextify
5. Grant permission when prompted for ~/.claude/ access
6. App will detect sample projects (taskflow, weatherly, recipebox)
7. Timeline displays conversations, LLM summaries generate automatically

FEATURES TO TEST:
• Timeline view - shows conversation history with timestamps
• LLM summaries - auto-generated for each conversation
• Quick Search (Cmd+F) - filter current project
• Deep Search (Cmd+Shift+F) - search across all projects
• Project switching - click tabs to switch between projects

The sample data contains synthetic Claude Code and Codex CLI transcript files demonstrating all app features.
